think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s data type and allowed values from PostgreSQL documentation. 2) Check whether it is a numeric knob with a natural ordering (e.g., integer/float ranges). 3) If numeric, check for sentinel values (commonly -1, 0) that switch the knob into a qualitatively different mode (e.g., auto/disable) compared to ordinary numeric scaling. 4) If the knob is boolean or enumerated (non-numeric), it does not fit the ‘special numerical knob’ definition. 5) Conclude whether it is a special knob and, if so, record the special value(s).
